name: Seth of Ikkuret
source:
The class jester, born to a storied lineage of doctors - the expectations of which cause him no end of grief. Close friends of both Theodoros and Ptolema, albeit for very different reasons. His gregarious demeanor, which charms some and grates on others, belies a surprisingly realist and somber temperament. He handles stress and complication exceptionally well; perhaps he missed his calling on the battlefield.

[From in-game encyclopedia]
